title: 131 Clinton Street
description:
PROPERTY FEATURES:
• Four dedicated, side-by-side off-street parking spaces — one per tenant, with no need to move your roommate's car!
• Spacious shared living areas and a beautifully renovated kitchen.
• Updated electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and bathrooms.
• Large backyard with a private patio, perfect for relaxing and spending time outdoors.
• Spacious front porch for enjoying evenings and weekends.
• Full-size washer and dryer located inside the home on the second floor next to bedrooms, exclusively for residents.
• Central air conditioning.
• Cat 6 Ethernet wired directly to every bedroom.
• Neighborhood sidewalks and nearby walking paths.
LOCATION:
• Located in the University District, north of The Ohio State University campus.
• Approximately six blocks from OSU.
• Two blocks east of High Street.
• Convenient access to COTA bus stops.
• Close to restaurants, shopping, and other neighborhood amenities.
• Approximately 0.5 miles from the Olentangy Trail.

AVAILABLE FOR SPRING SEMESTER 2027 ONLY
JANUARY 1 – JUNE 30, 2027
**4 BEDROOMS • 2.5 BATHS • 4 DEDICATED OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES**
Beautifully renovated, unfurnished 4-bedroom home available for a six-month lease near The Ohio State University!
RENTAL DETAILS
• $2,400 monthly base rent for the entire home ($600 per bedroom based on four occupants)
• Additional $25 per occupant per month for water
• Six-month lease: January 1 – June 30, 2027
• Maximum occupancy: 4
• Property is rented as one residence, not by individual bedroom
• Unfurnished
• Lease ends June 30, 2027; no extension beyond this date is available
ABOUT THE HOME
Located approximately 0.75 miles from Ohio State, this spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home combines the character and space of a house with the modern updates students want.
Beautifully renovated in 2023, the home features central A/C, in-unit laundry, a newer kitchen, updated electrical, Cat 6 Ethernet, and inviting private outdoor spaces.
The main floor offers a comfortable living room and bright, modern open-concept kitchen with plenty of room for group dinners, studying, and spending time with friends. A convenient half bath is also located on this level.
The second floor includes three bedrooms, a shared full bathroom, and a full-size washer and dryer — no basement laundry or trips to the laundromat!
The third floor features a private bedroom with its own en suite full bathroom, offering a separate retreat from the rest of the house.
Newer heating and central A/C provide year-round comfort, while Cat 6 Ethernet wired directly to every bedroom is ideal for streaming, gaming, studying, or video conferencing.
Outside, enjoy a welcoming front porch and private back patio with space for relaxing, grilling, and spending time outdoors.
And forget the daily parking scramble! Four dedicated, side-by-side off-street parking spaces are located directly behind the house — one for each resident, with no need to move your roommate's car.
Conveniently located near campus and COTA service, this home offers the space, privacy, parking, and amenities of a single-family home.
**PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS**
• 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms
• 4 dedicated side-by-side off-street parking spaces
• Renovated in 2023
• Newer kitchen and updated electrical
• Central air conditioning
• Full-size washer and dryer
• Cat 6 Ethernet wired to every bedroom
• Private front porch and back patio
• Approximately 6 blocks from OSU
INTERESTED IN THE SPRING 2027 LEASE?
Please reach out with your desired move-in date, the number of intended occupants, and confirmation that your group is seeking housing through June 30, 2027.
